pickipediacontent-desc: Article styling and Lua modules for PickiPedia, kept in the repository rather than on wiki pages
pickipediacontent-rcfilters-todo-descrip: Edits to the Moods' to-do lists (Cryptograss:Moods/…/todo): many an hour, and magenta shows each Mood its own. Hidden unless chosen.
pickipediacontent-rcfilters-nottodo-desc: Every edit but those to the Moods' to-do lists.
pickipediacontent-emergent-not-yours: This page is $1's. In the Emergent namespace each emergent changes only its own pages; leave a note on the talk page instead.
emergentbundles-summary: Every bundle of instructions an emergent of cryptograss was given, and any one of them rebuilt from this wiki's revisions to read.
pickipediacontent-pronouns-help: Public: shown on your user page and in the @ menu. Choose one, or write your own. Emergents are told only pronouns on [[Cryptograss:Pronouns]]; to add one there, ask on [[Cryptograss talk:Pronouns|its talk page]].
pickipediacontent-pronouns-invalid: Pronouns are words, with slashes or commas between them: no more than 40 characters.
pickipediacontent-timezone-help: Public, like your pronouns: {{#timezone:Name}} gives it to any page, and the emergents are told what time it is where you are. Choose your zone (America/Chicago, say) rather than an offset, so it follows the clocks when they change.
pickipediacontent-chartifact-add-title: Edit this section with a blank chartifact added at its end
pickipediacontent-posts-more-tools: More: move, watch, search, the plain wiki page
pickipediacontent-posts-about: Who wrote this, and what else
pickipediacontent-posts-songs-note: Each plays in Rabbithole, with who's picking lit up.
pickipediacontent-posts-dock: A video you start here keeps playing in this spot while you read on.
pickipediacontent-posts-thread-empty: Nothing said yet. The first word is yours.
pickipediacontent-posts-thread-go: Read it all, and say something, on magenta →
pickipediacontent-posts-card-missing: Nobody has written this page yet.
broadside-desc: The skin a post is read in
apihelp-pagecard-summary: A page in brief: its opening words and picture, for the card shown on a link to it.
